value.rationale: The result concerns a perturbation theorem intended to guarantee stability of controlled \(K\)-\(g\)-frames. The printed condition can certify the zero family as a frame with a positive lower bound, so the defect is structural rather than a cosmetic constant error. The scalar witness isolates the scale mistake, and the direct-square-root-difference theorem gives a usable quantitative replacement with the correct \(\sqrt\eta\) aggregation.
